programme.desc: S03 E06 — Berry Farm Charm For the first time ever Jon and Kristina renovate a home on a working berry farm; using salvaged pieces found on the farmstead, they design a glass bottle wall, a hanging plant feature, and completely transform the space.
programme.title: Farmhouse Fixer

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Saved by the Barn Jon and Kristina come to the rescue for a homeowner who is struggling with a post and beam barn; the barn is a party zone and includes a speakeasy, woodworking, a book club, a teen zone and life-size beer pong.
programme.title: Farmhouse Fixer

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Enter if You Dare Four designers remain in the competition to bring the once-grand Bihl Manor back to life; split into two teams, they'll revive the haunted halls on the first and second floors, but will the spirits and judges approve?
programme.title: A Very Haunted Renovation

programme.desc: S01 E04 — A Game of Haunts The four remaining designers split into two teams to transform the attic into both a spooky speakeasy and a gothic game room; but first, a spine-tingling game brings haunted surprises, pushing their nerves and upcycled feature projects to the limit.
programme.title: A Very Haunted Renovation

programme.desc: S01 E05 — The Exterior Exorcism And then there were three! For the first time, each designer tackles a space of their own as they transform Bihl Manor's neglected exterior. Battling the spirits and the elements, they're aiming to give the grounds a glow-up worthy of the judges.
programme.title: A Very Haunted Renovation

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Horror in the Ominous Ozarks Retta's journey to find scary takes her to the Ominous Ozarks where three homes duke it out for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria! It includes a home of devilish doppelgängers and a ghostly gangster meeting place.
programme.title: Scariest House in America

programme.desc: S03 E03 — The Eeriest of the East Retta's journey to find scary takes her to the Eerie East where four homes vie for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria! It includes a ghoulish home overrun with ghosts and a Victorian infested with spiders and apparitions.
programme.title: Scariest House in America

programme.desc: S03 E04 — Scares of the Mysterious Midwest Retta's journey takes her to the Mysterious Midwest where four homes contend for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria; it includes a ghostly home with a history of squatters and a Victorian full of ghosts and dolls.
programme.title: Scariest House in America

programme.desc: S03 E01 — Back to the Wild Kicking things off at a house with a 727 airplane inside; exploring a pink time capsule-esque penthouse.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E03 — Ranch Dressing Jack McBrayer searches for wild homes and goes chugga-chuggin' down to a cozy train caboose hideaway; next, he dreams in color at a pastel-painted ranch and stops by a desert dream oasis; only one home can reign supreme!
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Guess Who's Coming to Tour Jack McBrayer's hunt for wild continues as he takes a peekaboo inside a Brooklyn brownstone for sale and gets an update on a previous season's Wild House; later, he travels to Reunion, Florida, to tour a themed home with special guest David Bromstad.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Bubbly Abode Jack continues searching for wild homes; he pops inside a bubble-shaped house with seven domes; visits a stone hall from 1876 that has lived many lives; and climbs high into a towering treehouse created to fulfill a father's childhood dream.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E11 — King Pigs and Queen Bees Jack tours a home built as a labor of love and an even larger affection for murals; he also visits a maximalist Victorian mansion that takes visitors on a trip across the globe; later on, he views a dome-shaped home with a special place for bees.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E10 — Choose Your Adventure Things take an unusual turn as Jack steps into the '80s and visits a home featured in a popular supernatural show; a homeowner in Denmark shows off his digs, Jack visits a resort with 20 themed dwellings, a spaceship, a castle and a wizard's lair!
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S278 E01 — The Devil Wears Modern A cardiologist and mental health therapist couple are miles apart in their N.J. home search; he wants a factory loft while she prefers a suburban sanctuary, and with their budgets a million dollars apart, it may be a battle of style over substance.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S277 E05 — Leaving the Ex at the Old Address A newly engaged couple looks to move out of the home she bought with her ex in Little Rock, Arkansas; she's set on staying in the same neighborhood, but her partner's done living in someone else's past and wants a place that's a fresh start.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S272 E08 — Engineering a New Life A couple decides to buy their first home together in Columbus, Ohio; it's a hot market, and she wants to move fast, but he's an engineer and prefers to take his time to make sure they find the right place.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S275 E10 — Houston, We Have a Problem A couple with three young boys relocates to Houston for his job, and they want to go big; he wants a large, traditional fixer he can renovate to his taste, but she's willing to spend on a fully-updated turnkey house they can move into with ease.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S279 E11 — Rushing Into Things A couple engaged after 44 days looks to buy a beach house for themselves and their two daughters on Florida's Emerald Coast; she has high expectations for luxury living and is willing to pay for it, but he's more frugal and prefers to spend less.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S269 E10 — Shredding for the Wedding Architecture professionals disagree on what kind of home to buy before their wedding in Nashville, Tennessee; she wants a Southern charmer that's historic, but he prefers something modern that's move-in ready.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S02 E02 — I'm Back to Change the Game Alison challenges her new partner Josh to ditch the cookie-cutter Vegas look and embrace an elevated, custom design; she brings in antique bathroom doors and pushes him to rethink the kitchen's color palette, all in hopes of maximizing their profit.
programme.title: Sin City Rehab

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Rhinestone Throne Charlie and Courtney revive an outdated home with glimpses of mid-century Florida flair. On another project, a seashell-encrusted toilet is the least of Charlie and Courtney's worries about a home with serious moisture issues.
programme.title: Botched Homes

programme.desc: S261 E08 — Georgia Coach Takes One for the Team After landing a college football head coaching job, a couple looks for a new home near campus in Carrollton, Ga.; he's focused on a modern ranch with room to host his players, but she wants a two-story Craftsman that's near the action in Atlanta.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S276 E02 — Queer Eye for the High Rise Opposites attract as an accountant searching for homey vibes clashes with her frugal partner in Chicago; one doesn't want to leave the city's gay district, while the other craves high-rise glam to prove she's made it.
programme.title: House Hunters
